acceptance: Full eight-expert check loss decrease > max(1e-6, twice the range of three repeated starting-check evaluations). No confidence or speed gate. Full prefix first-choice result; no fallback rescue counted as acceptance.
clock_policy: Restore complete checkpoint at 1024; advance through 17408. Preserve native optimizer built with schedule_steps=2698, including Muon/Adam 5% floors and native slow-momentum/weight-decay tails. No schedule rescaling, restart or state reset. First 1674 updates use the original decay; remaining 14710 use its floor.
state_policy: Same complete state coordinates for all expert counts; native evaluation applies pending quantile values. Independent on-device copies, exact input equality and retained-source isolation after donated updates. Native output bitwise determinism is not assumed.
comparison: Four-expert and native-eight branches on the same allocation, starting state and new paired data window; alternate execution order by trial. Three checkpoint seeds by four disjoint training-index windows, shared across seeds. Full eight-expert raw-weight endpoint evaluation with pending routing adjustments.
measurement: Check batch excluded from training; four fresh monitor batches excluded from selection. All are unused windows of the same pretraining stream. This is an independent-checkpoint screen, not continuing accepted-block training.
failure_policy: Nonfinite draft training loss stops that trajectory and marks all unreached horizons rejected, separately labeled. Nonfinite endpoint check rejects that prefix. Nonfinite native loss/evaluation aborts the run for diagnosis. Exceptions are not converted to rejections.
screen_rule: Report all12pairedwindows and per-seed values through16384, acceptance, matched-update cost and matched-loss cost. Acceptance remains the prior usefulness check, not an efficiency claim.
expansion_rule: User requests 16384 updates. Stop at 16384; report all declared horizons, no adaptive expansion or pruning.
confirmation_rule: Twelve paired windows through 16384. No selection or separate confirmation stage.
cost: Minimal proposal cost includes updates+initialcopy+baselinecheck+candidatecheck; native update execution denominator. Also report every prefix check, calibration, fresh monitoring, data preload, restore/compile and whole-job allocation separately. Both use8H100; GPU-hours=executionseconds*8/3600. No full production latency claim from preloaded data.
authorization: User requested16384 updates, RNO2A interactive requested, at most256H100 concurrently, no cumulative GPU-hour gate. Twelve8H100jobs=96H100peak. No architecture changes.
primary_analysis: Primary: paired cost to common fresh-loss reductions0.02,0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.25,0.30nats/token from the common checkpoint. Report observed crossing intervals and uncrossed targets; interpolate only bracketed targets. Also compare draft endpoints with native at equal minimal execution cost where native observations bracket that cost. Call an observed sustained crossover only when draft has positive paired median equal-cost advantage at three consecutive measured draft horizons, with per-seed and12pair counts shown; disclose the interpolation. Report raw measured endpoint dominance when available. No claim of first exact crossing or population confidence. Extend the same predeclared common-loss target grid with0.35,0.40,0.45,0.50,0.60,0.70,0.80,1.00nats/token; preserve uncrossed targets.
projection_comparison: Compare against the completed 4096-update study and its brief near-tie at1536. New disjoint windows; this is not an exact continuation of saved4096 endpoints. The 4096 outputs did not preserve final optimizer checkpoints.
